decisions.statement: A test proving code written in TSX is written in TSX too.
This ceiling refuses a test file rather than throttling that file.
A test file over it is made cheaper or is no test.
A test file held under the memory it needs pays the reclaim as its own processor time.
This ceiling is above what a test file loading a parser needs to load it.
Nothing refuses a test file for the memory that file peaks at.
